debug.changelog:
fix: keep the proxy path prefix when rewriting API requests

The Deno deployment serves the website at the root and mounts the Proton
proxy under /api, but the rewriting interceptor only replaced the scheme,
host and port of each request. The /api prefix from the base URL was
dropped, so a session refresh went to /auth/v4/refresh on the website
itself and came back as 405 Method Not Allowed, which surfaced as an
endless refresh failure in SessionManager.

The prefix from the configured proxy URL is now prepended to the rewritten
path, ahead of the verify-api/verify prefixes that were already handled.
Proxies that live at the root, such as the Netlify one the native clients
use, are unaffected because their base URL has no path segments.

release.changelog:
feat: integrate AI-driven changelog generation into CI/CD

- Replaced the basic git-based changelog generation in `.woodpecker.yml` with a custom Python-based AI solution.
- Updated the `generate-changelog` CI step to use a Python 3.11 environment and install `google-generativeai`.
- Introduced `scripts/generate_ai_changelog.py` which utilizes the Gemini API to summarize commit history between tags.
- Added support for configurable AI models and custom prompts via `GEMINI_MODEL` and `CHANGELOG_PROMPT` environment variables.
- Implemented logic within the script to automatically identify the previous release tag and fetch relevant commit logs.
- Included an implementation plan and walkthrough documentation for the new integration.
